method.T: 00:00 America/New_York on the first publication date; T balance excludes transactions at or after T
method.T_pub: 12:00 America/New_York; first outflow is first >=T, lag against T_pub may be negative on the designation morning
method.balances: from-zero signed transfer amounts minus fees, only on complete histories that reconcile per asset with current saved state; today's direct observations remain usable on incomplete histories
method.checkpoints: T-7d, T, T+7d, T+30d, T+365d use ET calendar dates; future or uncovered endpoints are null; today is each latest saved state
method.depletion: sum_asset(max(0, balance_T - balance_checkpoint) * price_T) / sum_asset(balance_T * price_T); no lot tracing; recognised priced assets only
method.dust_and_spam: recognised-contract/native transfers >=1 USD at transfer time; unknown contracts and zero amounts excluded. Unknown asset native quantities remain in CSV, never valued from ticker
method.entities: distinct SDN UIDs in each row/group, not persons or independent wallets; groups/programs overlap and must not be added
method.exchange_scale: more than 10,000 distinct observed transaction hashes, or fetcher huge_address/reported_history_records >10,000; incomplete lower-count histories may conceal scale
method.first_outflow_median: conditional on observed non-dust movers with complete history and prices, not population survival time; non-movers are censored
method.inflows: total_inflow_after_usd covers non-dust recognised assets only; partial/unpriced recognised histories return null plus a priced subtotal
method.prices: scripts/prices/price.py usd(); checkpoint time or transfer time. WETH/ETH, WBTC/BTC, and BSC pegged USDT/USDC use underlying-price proxies, not independent wrapper market quotes
method.provisional: completed bounded acquisition; the manifest hashes identify this read pass, not a simultaneous multi-chain snapshot
method.same_address_other_chain: separate view, anchored at the earliest publication of the same 0x string on a listed EVM chain; excluded from listed-chain aggregates
method.tornado_exclusion: primary population excludes all identifiers under an OFAC name containing TORNADO, plus independently identified pool/router/proxy addresses; matches the pre-move reference. tornado_contract retains the narrower role flag; tornado_excluded records the broader population rule
method.untrackable: ledger trackable flag preserved, shown in separate rows even where a fetcher later found a working route (e.g. BTG)
